parameters.objective: All unordered legal-action pairs with nontrivial teacher margin, excluding pairs where neither correction is permitted; equal total pair weight per root. Same fixed features, capacity and hyperparameters as v1.
parameters.tuning: One fixed fit, no held-out hyperparameter selection or refitting after tournaments. Production is the zero-delta baseline.

scope: Internal rounded teacher score regret on retained grouped development roots; not win probability, not independent strength validation. For v2 the old held-out set informed this repair and is development evidence only.
